title: How to Ask Better Questions? A Large-Scale Multi-Domain Dataset for Rewriting Ill-Formed Questions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of rewriting ill-formed questions to be well-formed, evaluating models based on grammatical, spelling, and semantic criteria. While one example question mentions 'Ethical Investing', the paper does not have any component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking morals, ethics, or faith.
